desc.p: Maps SNOMED CT medicinal products to a SNOMED CT route of administration. Source is the value set Medicinal Products (SNOMED) (2.16.840.1.113883.3.1937.777.100.11.15). SNOMED CT carries no route attribute on the product. The route is derived in two steps: 411116001 |Has manufactured dose form| gives the dose form, and the dose form carries 736474004 |Has dose form intended site|. Every dose form was resolved with ValueSet/$expand over ECL dotted notation against the International Edition, version 20260901. All targets are descendants of 284009009 |Route of administration value|. 317 of 356 products are mapped. The remaining 39 either carry a parenteral dose form, where the product does not determine whether administration is intravenous, intramuscular or subcutaneous, or carry no dose form at all because they are broader product concepts; both are deliberately absent rather than mapped to an assumed route.
